# routeros_ip_cloud_back_to_home_file (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ip_cloud_back_to_home_file" "file" {
  path          = "example"
  allow_uploads = true
  comment       = "Managed by OpenTofu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Path of the file or of the directory on the router that is being shared.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `allow_uploads` (Boolean) Enables the option for anyone holding the share link to upload files to the router. Applicable to shared directories.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `expires` (String) Date and time when the share expires, in the ISO 8601 `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` form (for example `2026-01-25 00:00:00`).

### Read-Only

- `direct_url` (String) Direct download link of the share (the `url` with the `?dl` parameter appended).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `url` (String) Generated HTTPS link of the share.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ip/cloud/back-to-home-file get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ip_cloud_back_to_home_file.file "*1"
```
